rows.grounds: compound adjective qualifying iyam; internal members mahat, mukhya, prakhyā
inherent, belonging to itself; qualifies vibhavam
demonstrative pronoun referring to the state described

items.question: What kind of inherent glory does this renowned state declare?
premises: This state is renowned as great and chief.
The declared glory is its own inherent nature.
items.inference: This renowned state proclaims its own inherent glory.
uncertainties: The precise compound structure of mahat+mukhya+prakhyā admits alternative internal relations.
items.plain_english: This, renowned as great and supreme, declares its own inherent glory.
